deployment_items.description: Provisions infrastructure through HCP Terraform's no-code provisioning workflow: creates a dedicated workspace from the pinned no-code module, sets the workspace variables from the form's Module Variables panel, adopts the auto-queued run, and pauses the job for human plan review before any apply. 'Continue Job' approves and applies the plan; canceling the job rejects it and discards the TFC run.
deployment_items.name: HCP Terraform No-Code Module

description: Provisions infrastructure through HCP Terraform using its no-code provisioning workflow: one blueprint targets one pinned no-code registry module, and a static custom form collects that module's input variables. Per deployment, the build plugin creates a dedicated workspace FROM the module, sets the workspace variables from the form (sensitive/HCL supported), adopts the run HCP auto-queues into a human plan-approval pause, and stores the workspace ID plus EVERY Terraform state output (auto-discovered) on the resource. HCP Terraform owns state and the cloud credentials (project-scoped variable set), so no environment or resource handler appears on the order form. The TFC connection, organization, project, and no-code module ID are pinned per blueprint via parameter_defaults. Requires at least one 'tf-cloud'-labeled ConnectionInfo (TEAM or user token -- org tokens are rejected by the no-code endpoints) and the tfc_api shared module config block (see docs/hcp-no-code-setup.md).
name: HCP Terraform No-Code Module

teardown_items.description: Destroys the deployment's infrastructure via an auto-confirmed TFC destroy run, then deletes its dedicated workspace via the safe-delete endpoint. Idempotent and PROVFAILED-tolerant: a missing or already-deleted workspace is a warning, not a failure.
teardown_items.name: Teardown HCP Terraform No-Code Module
